prompt:
After an OTA update, CarService crashes right after boot on head units that have a Wi-Fi module, and the car comes up with no audio or display. Head units without Wi-Fi boot fine. The crash from logcat:
E AndroidRuntime: FATAL EXCEPTION: CarServiceMain
E AndroidRuntime: Process: com.android.car, PID: 1432
E AndroidRuntime: java.lang.NullPointerException: Attempt to invoke virtual method 'void com.android.car.power.ComponentState.set(boolean)' on a null object reference
E AndroidRuntime: 	at com.android.car.power.PowerComponentHandler.setState(PowerComponentHandler.java:42)
E AndroidRuntime: 	at com.android.car.power.PowerComponentHandler.applyPolicy(PowerComponentHandler.java:34)
E AndroidRuntime: 	at com.android.car.power.CarPowerManagementService.applyPowerPolicy(CarPowerManagementService.java:25)
E AndroidRuntime: 	at com.android.car.power.CarPowerManagementService.onBootCompleted(CarPowerManagementService.java:16)
Find the fault in packages/services/Car. Answer with the file and the function that contain it, and one sentence on why. Do not change any file.
reference_answer: packages/services/Car/service/src/com/android/car/power/PowerComponentHandler.java, setState: it dereferences the state of a component that was never registered (WIFI is in the all_on policy but not registered), so get() returns null.
